ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Douglas Kirkland, known for his highly artistic portraits of Hollywood celebrities, was born in Toronto, Canada. When he was young, he eagerly awaited the weekly arrival of Life magazine and discussed the photographs the magazine contained with his father. Believing that he would have better career prospects, Kirkland moved to the United States after graduating from high school and found work at a photography studio. When Look magazine hired him at age 24, he became their second-youngest photographer ever. His photos taken of Marilyn Monroe in 1961 became iconic almost instantly. Kirkland spent his weeks shooting day-to-day life across the United States and his weekends in exotic locations. His photo essays could run up to a dozen pages and were seen by more than half of all Americans.

det.analysis: 'the __________ (week) arrival of Life magazine'에서 명사 arrival을 수식하는 형용사가 필요. week(명사) → weekly(형용사, 매주의). the weekly arrival = 매주의 도착
det.tip: weekly = 매주의 (형용사). week → weekly

questions.passage: Douglas Kirkland, known for his highly artistic portraits of Hollywood celebrities, was born in Toronto, Canada. When he was young, he eagerly awaited the weekly arrival of Life magazine and discussed the photographs the magazine contained with his father. Believing that he would have better career prospects, Kirkland moved to the United States after graduating from high school and found work at a photography studio. When Look magazine hired him at age 24, he became their second-youngest photographer ever. His photos taken of Marilyn Monroe in 1961 became iconic almost instantly. Kirkland spent his weeks shooting day-to-day life across the United States and his weekends in exotic locations. His photo essays could run up to a dozen pages and were seen by more than half of all Americans.

det.analysis:
❌ ① 두 잡지의 경쟁: 잡지는 그의 경력의 배경일 뿐
❌ ② 유명인사 사생활: 본문 주제가 아님
❌ ③ 스튜디오 운영법: 운영 방법을 다루지 않음
✅ ④ 한 인물의 성장: 어린 시절 사진에 대한 관심을 바탕으로 유명 사진작가가 된 인물의 생애가 핵심 ←정답
det.tip: 글 전체 = 어린 시절 관심을 사진작가 경력으로 발전시킨 인물

det.korean: ② 어린 시절의 열정이 영향력 있는 사진작가로 이끌었다

❌ ① 상업적 가치 없음: 본문과 무관
✅ ② 열정이 성공으로: 어린 시절 사진에 대한 관심이 미국 이주, 잡지사 고용, 상징적 사진으로 이어져 영향력 있는 사진작가가 되었다는 것이 요지 ←정답
❌ ③ 주말에만 일함: 일부 사실의 왜곡
❌ ④ 캐나다 성공 불가: 본문과 무관
det.tip: 요지 = 어린 시절 열정 → 영향력 있는 사진작가

ch: 어린 시절의 사진에 대한 열정이 그를 영향력 있는 사진작가로 이끌었다.
